request.subject: numbers stale again
request.body: Finance says the numbers they work from have been stale for a few days now. Is this the same thing you're already looking at, or something new? We close the quarter soon so need to know.

rationale: Acme has two distinct open data-freshness problems: the scheduled-export outage (work_export_issue, blocked; Acme's request_exports_acme_retry) and warehouse sync lag after schema changes (work_warehouse_sync_backfill, in_progress; request_acme_warehouse_sync_lag). The message does not say whether finance consumes delivered export files or warehouse tables, so either link could be wrong. One targeted question (which delivery path / which dataset) is the correct move (spec J2). No new work: both candidates already exist. 'Quarter close' must not produce a delivery date: work_export_issue has no forecast and depends on a blocked chain.
notes: Terse; linking either item without asking is a guess.
